changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwappointmentrequest AS SELECT ar.id, ar.patient_id, ar.facility_id, ar.department_id, ar.source_encounter_id, ar.appointment_id, ar.requested_resource_type, ar.requested_resource_id, ar.priority, ar.reason, ar.note, ar.status, ar.cancelled_at, ar.cancel_reason, ar.created_by, ar.created_date, ar.last_modified_by, ar.last_modified_date, ar.preferred_date FROM public.appointment_request ar;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwappointmentrequest TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwappointmentrequest FROM report_user;
